WIC28A-01.note: Fewer than 30 kills a year, yet elk turned vigilant even with the pack 30 miles off: intimidation, not chasing or ambush; elk scattered, so not corralled.

WIC28A-02.note: Voles settle and stay near entry, so it is no corridor; most die to owls there while those leaving breed, so a death site. Cafeteria tempts via seed-heavy grass.

WIC28A-03.note: Cleaning station: shrimp groom visiting fish briefly; shrimp-removal control shows a parasite-relief function. Canteen is the near-miss (shrimp feed).

WIC28A-04.note: Bottom draw of a 300-ft reservoir gives cold water; bass leave and trout move in. Gravel bars still rolled and at same depth rule out bled/clogged/churned. Needs background inference about deep-water temperature.

WIC28A-05.note: Port busier than ever shipping to neutrals and council still appoints the harbormaster, so not blockaded/annexed/bombarded; wool vanished only from alliance markets: boycott.

WIC28A-06.note: Church demolished and stones broken for a roadbed; walls sound weakens condemned, though condemned (sentenced to demolition) is a residual near-miss. Bulldozed fits.

WIC28A-07.note: Masts flat on the water and crews clinging to keels decides it in one sentence; becalmed is opposite of a squall.

WIC28A-08.note: Brief feast drawing scavengers from miles that scatter when flesh is gone: banquet. Cupboard (stored supply) is the only near-miss and fails on transience.

WIC28B-01.note: Netted flowers drop unfertilized; probed flowers set fruit; insects/caterpillar lines kill patrolled. Propagated is close since fruit leads to seedlings, but fruit falls unopened beneath the tree (no spread), so pollinated is more precise.

WIC28B-02.note: Count unchanged (not reduced), pairs on old ledges (not redistributed/rattled), old and crippled culled and more chicks survive: rejuvenated.

WIC28B-03.note: Cheap editions tempt pirated, but each is licensed and pays her share and she is credited; praise rules out panned.

WIC28B-04.note: Orderly crating, numbered list and signed receipt, buyback refused: requisitioned. Repatriated tempts via the collection's looted origin, but items went to the foundry and HQ.

WIC28B-05.note: Ingredients plus sprouting/crushing steps with day counts, scaled column, brewer's seal: recipe. Receipt tempts via amounts and seal.

WIC28B-06.note: Journey to a spring shared with another parish, ribbon offerings, water carried for the ill: pilgrimage. Pageant and roundup lure via hats and ponies.

WIC28B-07.note: Goods left for cash, redeemed for sum plus a tenth or else sold: pawnshop. Repository is the near-miss.

WIC28B-08.note: Same wheel tracks pressed lower, two long lines of standing water: ruts. Flat at braking spot rules out rippled (washboarding).

WIC28C-01.note: Slowing transfers via leaves ants crossed, far from ants, within an hour: a chemical sedation, so drugged. Herded (keeping aphids on the plant) remains a plausible second reading.

WIC28C-02.note: Outline intact on open sand rules out dismantled/entombed; plank surface smooth, barnacles only on slates, rules out encrusted; pencil-lead holes and weightless crumbling wood = shipworm gnawing.

WIC28C-03.note: Fire stopped by the river not the wall (firebreak trap); open at both ends (not fence); warm bricks protect peaches from frost: hearth.

WIC28C-04.note: Discards marked destroyed, bricked up, never reopened: dump. Depository tempts via cool dry storage conditions.

WIC28C-05.note: Pale powdery cores behind ivy vs damp bare half; rootlets leave no mark; gale took no stone from either half, so neither fortified nor dislodged: dried.

WIC28C-06.note: Bare earth and stones vs covered slope: denuded. Fertilized fails because droppings wash away before breaking down.

WIC28C-07.note: Faithful copy except falsified channel and invented shoals at the navy's harbor: doctored.

WIC28C-08.note: Spoil heaped on banks and pools three feet deeper, no dams and water level unchanged, same aspens and brown grass: dredged.

WIC28D-01.note: Clear water draining through loose sand strips nutrients; corn pale despite fertilizer; dry blowing sand rules out mired; clear water rules out manured.

WIC28D-02.note: Fertilizer and mud leave as they came (not kidney/net); oxygen loss kills lung; exported stems feed shrimp: kitchen.

WIC28D-03.note: Doorways at original height and houses kept (not buried/nibbled), only access a three-day walk over dunes: imprisoned.

WIC28D-04.note: Visitors from both sides in equal numbers on same evenings, cross-group friendships rose: mixer. Magnet fails (ordinary draw, all local); junction weaker.

WIC28D-05.note: Frozen bed kept meadow soil (not milled), debris in one ridge at the mouth (not littered/mantled), meltwater cut a deep slot: incised.

WIC28D-06.note: Editors cooperate and run appeals, no prior review (not muzzled), families own and profit (not nationalized/impoverished): mobilized.

WIC28D-07.note: Current-dropped sand buried the wreck, so interred; but timbers preserved from shipworms invite mummified, though soft, wet, black timbers argue against a desiccation image. Seawater as the agent of burial is slightly loose.

WIC28D-08.note: Relocated to England with English names and money, nothing cut, rhythm kept: naturalized (domesticated).

WIC28E-01.note: Free crossing without pilot, public buoys (not tollbooth/turnstile), ships tie up at piers (not wharf), bar breaks the swells protecting moored boats: seawall.

WIC28E-02.note: No tree died (not toppled/winnowed), needles kept (not scorched), narrow rings and beetle susceptibility across sizes: sapped.

WIC28E-03.note: Size grading downstream and painted stones settling among same-size stones: sorted. Color through the stone rules out stained; refitting broken pebbles rules out sanded.

WIC28E-04.note: Daily evening rise that mills start by: timepiece. Front at same ledge through cold and hot decades kills thermometer; ditches on springs kills storeroom; no path kills signpost.

WIC28E-05.note: Word count unchanged (not tightened), curses kept (not softened), spelling/punctuation fixed and dates moved per her own corrections: tidied.

WIC28E-06.note: Riffles turned into a half-mile slow pond, whole flow passes the wheel (not siphoned), trout thrive (not soured): stilled.

WIC28E-07.note: 28 men lost with hatches battened: tomb. Coal holds kill strongbox; 90-ft depth vs 20-ft draft kills tripwire; coral growth is reef-wide so trellis fails.

WIC28E-08.note: Gate wine sales to travelers out-earned field rent: tavern. Coin chests emptied each spring kill vault; books bought kill scriptorium.
